description: Changes the access rules on a Sitecore item. action 'add' appends one rule and leaves the others; 'replace' discards every existing rule on the item and leaves only this one; 'clear' removes all rules and adds nothing. Read the current rules with security-get-item-acl and check effective rights with security-test-item-acl.

accessRight.description: The access right the rule covers, e.g. 'item:read'. Required for add and replace; not allowed for clear.

action.description: add appends a rule; replace discards all existing rules and leaves only this one; clear removes all rules.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

id.description: The ID of the item. Supply this or path.

identity.description: The account the rule applies to, e.g. 'sitecore\Author'. Required for add and replace; not allowed for clear.

passThru.description: Return the processed item, projected to its identity.

path.description: The path of the item (e.g. /sitecore/content/Home). Supply this or id.

propagationType.description: How far the rule propagates: Entity is this item only, Descendants the whole subtree. Sitecore has no children-only propagation.

securityPermission.description: Whether the rule allows or denies the right, or allows/denies inheritance of it.

name: security-set-item-acl
